meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 转为编排者:派子代理执行计划的各个阶段,每阶段后派子代理做验证、反模式检查与代码质量审查,只有验证通过才提交。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 按计划执行,每个阶段完成后先验证再提交
say.note: 会派子代理分阶段执行并验证

say.text: 把这份计划跑起来,从第一阶段开始
这一阶段验证没过就别提交,先报告问题
say.note: 验证失败时停下并汇报

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it deploys subagents to execute each phase of the plan, then runs verification, anti-pattern, and code-quality checks, committing only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one produced by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute the plan; verify each phase before committing
say_en.note: Subagents run and verify phase by phase

say_en.text: Run this plan, starting with phase one
If this phase fails verification, don't commit — report first
say_en.note: Stops the commit and reports issues
